headings: CANDIDATE ACTIVITY BOARD for PG Counselling
notice_texts: LATEST NEWS BAMS-BHMS & BNYS Round-3 (Mop-up Round) Allotment Result has been published. New As per the order of the Government of India, Ministry of Ayush Dated 19.10.2026, the 2nd appeal filed by "Bharti ayurved medical college and hospital, Durg" has been disposed with denial of permission for admission by Central Government. So, no allotment has been done against seats of Bharti Ayurved Medical College and Hospital, Durg. New "माननीय उच्च न्यायालय, बिलासपुर द्वारा भारती आयुर्वेद चिकित्सा महाविद्यालय एवं चिकित्सालय, दुर्ग को याचिका क्र. 5296/2026 के अनुसार शैक्षणिक सत्र 2026-27 हेतु 100 सीटों के लिए काउंसिलिंग प्रक्रिया में सम्मिलित होने की सशर्त अनुमति दी गयी है। प्रवेश की अनुमति महाविद्यालय को नहीं मिली है जो कि याचिकाकर्ता महाविद्यालय द्वारा भारतीय चिकित्सा पद्धति राष्ट्रीय आयोग (NCISM), नई दिल्ली के समक्ष दायर द्वितीय अपील के निर्णय के अधीन होगी। द्वितीय अपील के निर्णय में भारती आयुर्वेद चिकित्सा महाविद्यालय एवं चिकित्सालय, दुर्ग को प्रवेश की अनुमति नहीं मिलने की स्थिति में सीट आबंटन के पश्चात् भी अभ्यर्थियों को प्रवेश नहीं दिया जायेगा। अतः अभ्यर्थियों को सूचित किया जाता है कि उपरोक्त तथ्यों को ध्यान में रखते हुए महाविद्यालय का विकल्प चयन करें।" The Hon’ble High Court of Bilaspur has granted conditional permission to Bharti Ayurveda Medical College and Hospital, Durg, to participate in the counselling process for 100 seats for the academic session 2026–27, in accordance with Petition No. 5296/2026. However, the college has not been granted permission to admit students, and the matter shall be subject to the outcome of the second appeal filed by the petitioner college before NCISM. In the event that permission to admit students is not granted to Bharti Ayurveda Medical College and Hospital, Durg, pursuant to the decision in the second appeal, candidates shall not be admitted to the college even after the allotment of seats. Therefore, candidates are hereby advised to select the college as an option in the counselling process only after taking the above facts i
